_comment: The editorial layer that sits on top of the auto-ranker. Everything here is optional; an empty
file produces a purely stat-weight-driven site.
'warrior.fury.p2'  a single spec in a single phase
pin      itemId -> slot. Forces the item into that slot regardless of score.
exclude  [itemId]. Removes the item from consideration entirely.
bonus    itemId -> number. Added to the item's score. Use for set bonuses, on-use and proc
effects, and weapon-speed breakpoints the parser cannot see. Scale matches the
spec's weights, so for a physical spec a bonus of 50 is worth 50 attack power.
note     itemId -> string. Shown in the UI next to the item. Any item carrying a pin, a
bonus or a note is badged as manually adjusted so the reasoning is visible.
The entries below are illustrative starting points, not a finished curation pass.
_scopeWarning: Resist the temptation to put item bonuses in the '*' scope. A bonus there applies to casters
and healers too: Drake Fang Talisman under '*' pushed a melee trinket into a Fire mage's list,
because the bonus outweighed the fact that none of its stats are useful to a caster. Physical
bonuses belong on the physical classes, and vice versa.
_excludeComment: Items the database carries that are not obtainable loot: GM and test weapons. They are excluded
in the '*' scope rather than per-class, because 'not real loot' is not a property of who is
Quality 6 (artifact) items — the Warglaives of Azzinoth and the Twin Blades — are dropped by the
scraper itself and need no entry here.

_duplicateKeyWarning: One block per scope. A second block with the same key does not merge - JSON keeps the last
one and the first is silently discarded, which is how the Drake Fang Talisman bonuses for
shaman.enhancement, paladin.retribution and druid.feral stopped applying when the relic
rankings were added below. Both sets of entries now live in the single block for each.

note.12640: Lionheart Helm is a threat/DPS helm; for pure mitigation prefer the defensive alternatives listed below.

note._: Combat rogues want a slow main hand and a fast off hand. The engine scores weapon DPS only, so check the speed column before committing to a pairing.

_relicComment: Relics carry no stats, so the stat-weight engine has nothing to rank them on and auto-fill
would leave the slot empty. They do have effect text, and it is specific enough to order them
by hand: 'Gives your Stormstrike a 35% chance to...' is plainly an Enhancement totem.
These bonuses are relative, not absolute. A relic only ever competes with other relics for the
same slot, so what matters is the ordering within a spec, not the size of the number. 30 is the
spec's pick, 20 and 10 are the runners-up. Anything unlisted still appears in the picker.
Read off each relic's own tooltip, not off logs. Correct freely.
